scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts docs eval README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.eval.json .github/workflows/check.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test scripts docs eval README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.eval.json .github/workflows/check.yml
scripts.smoke:mcp:live: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/live-mcp.ts
scripts.smoke:repository:live: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/live-mcp.ts --repository-test
scripts.eval:tasks:live: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/evaluate-tasks.ts
